mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_document_share (id, document_id, owner_id, share_scope, link_token_hash, expires_at, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{idHex}), HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{ownerIdHex}), 'LINK', #{token}, #{expiresAt}, 'A')

INSERT INTO edudoc_share_grant (id, share_id, principal_type, principal_ref, permission_level, granted_by) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{idHex}), HEXTORAW(#{shareIdHex}), 'GROUP', 'LINK', #{permissionLevel}, HEXTORAW(#{grantedByHex}))
mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(s.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(s.document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(s.owner_id) AS ownerId, s.share_scope AS shareScope, s.link_token_hash AS linkToken, s.expires_at AS expiresAt, s.create_time AS createTime, s.status AS status, g.permission_level AS permission
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_document_share s LEFT JOIN edudoc_share_grant g ON g.share_id = s.id AND g.principal_type = 'GROUP' AND g.principal_ref = 'LINK' WHERE s.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM edudoc_document_share s LEFT JOIN edudoc_share_grant g ON g.share_id = s.id AND g.principal_type = 'GROUP' AND g.principal_ref = 'LINK' WHERE s.link_token_hash = #{token}
SELECT FROM edudoc_document_share s LEFT JOIN edudoc_share_grant g ON g.share_id = s.id AND g.principal_type = 'GROUP' AND g.principal_ref = 'LINK' WHERE s.id = HEXTORAW(#{shareIdHex})
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_document_share SET status = 'R', update_time = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{shareIdHex}) AND status = 'A'
UPDATE edudoc_document_share SET status = 'E', update_time = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{shareIdHex}) AND status = 'A'
